# اِسْتَمَعْتَ (istamaʕta) /is.ta.maʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اِسْتَمَعْتِ (istamaʕti) /is.ta.maʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اِسْتَمَعَتْ (istamaʕat) /is.ta.ma.ʕat/: third-perso
